title: iFLA commercial piggery program
summary: Introducing a commercial piggery project with iFLA, SkyGreen and ZimFete funding.
body:
SkyGreen supplies two-month-old female gilts at $125 each. Participants must purchase at least four gilts, costing $500 before feed and chemicals.

iFLA provides a boar to service the gilts. After they give birth, the farmer gives iFLA one gilt as payment for boar servicing.

ZimFete normally requires a deposit of at least 50% of the total project cost. For this project, the agreed terms are a $50 account-opening amount and a deposit of at least $200. These are separate from SACCO membership fees.

ZimFete funds the remaining pig purchase cost and the full feed cost. Ask an officer to confirm chemical costs and the complete project budget before proceeding.

Interest is 30% of the total loan received. Repayment starts six months from the date the loan is issued. Confirm the instalment schedule and repayment duration with ZimFete before accepting finance.

Contact ZimFete to confirm eligibility and apply.
